title: Stasis: Vortex Orb Emporium
description: A surreal cosmic scene viewed from above shows a large glowing green vortex orb with alien embryo at its center, surrounded by swirling purple and blue energy. Around the orb are various mystical and scientific stations with computers, an open book with glowing blue hands, a circular control panel with star map, scattered planets, and red banners with symbols in a circular arrangement.
prompt: Top-down view of a mystical emporium centered around a large glowing green vortex orb containing an alien embryo, surrounded by swirling cosmic energy and magical runes. Arranged in a circle are computer workstations, red banners with symbols, an open spellbook with glowing blue hands, a circular control panel with star maps and crystals, and floating planets. Vibrant surreal fantasy style with intricate details and ethereal lighting.
